# James Kehl Architects

> Residential architecture practice led by James Kehl, RA, an Ohio registered architect, working anywhere in Ohio.

## Facts

- James Kehl Architects is a residential architecture practice in Ohio, founded in 2023.
- The principal and owner is James Kehl, RA, an Ohio registered architect.
- James Kehl is also registered as an architect in California; the practice works only in Ohio.
- The practice works anywhere in Ohio, remotely first, with a site visit when the job needs one.
- The practice is based in Licking County, Ohio.
- Services: pole barn and post-frame building drawings; permit drawings for additions and renovations; new custom homes; zoning and site plans; construction documents for builders.
- James Kehl holds a Master of Architecture from the Yale School of Architecture and a Bachelor of Science in Architecture from the University of Cincinnati.
- James Kehl has about 13 years of experience in residential, commercial and institutional architecture, including work at HGA, Matt Peterson Studio, Studio William Hefner, Kohn Pedersen Fox and REX.
- James Kehl leads every project personally, from the first conversation through construction.
- Every job starts with a call and a short written agreement setting out the scope.
- Telephone: 740-258-7575. Email: james@jameskehlarchitects.com. Website: https://jameskehlarchitects.com.

## Services

- [Pole barn and post-frame building drawings](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/pole-barn-drawings-ohio/): Permit-ready pole barn and post-frame drawings by an Ohio registered architect: floor plan, elevations, sections, framing and a zoning site plan, anywhere in Ohio.
- [Permit drawings for additions and renovations](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/permit-drawings-ohio/): Permit drawings for additions, renovations, garages and porches by an Ohio registered architect. Existing conditions, new design, code review and plan review answers.
- [New custom home design](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/custom-home-architect-ohio/): New custom homes designed by an Ohio registered architect, from site and program through construction drawings and construction. Remote first, statewide.
- [Zoning and site plans](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/zoning-site-plans-ohio/): Scaled zoning site plans for Ohio townships, counties and cities: lot lines, setbacks, structures, drives, well and septic, drawn by an Ohio registered architect.
- [Construction documents for builders](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/builders/): Construction documents and permit sets for Ohio home builders by an Ohio registered architect: coordinated drawings, permit submission and plan review answers.

## Regions

- [Central Ohio](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/regions/central-ohio/): An Ohio registered architect based in Licking County, drawing homes, additions, pole barns and site plans across Franklin, Delaware, Licking, Fairfield and Union counties.
- [Columbus suburbs](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/regions/columbus-suburbs/): Custom homes, additions and teardown rebuilds in New Albany, Granville, Upper Arlington, Dublin and Powell, designed to each town's review rules by an Ohio registered architect.
- [Northeast Ohio](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/regions/northeast-ohio/): Permit drawings, custom homes, pole barns and site plans across Northeast Ohio from an Ohio registered architect, with designs set for snowbelt loads and local review.
- [Eastern Ohio and the Ohio Valley](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/regions/eastern-ohio/): Pole barn drawings, site plans, additions and homes in Columbiana, Jefferson, Carroll, Belmont and Tuscarawas counties, by an Ohio registered architect.
- [Southwest Ohio](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/regions/southwest-ohio/): Custom homes, additions, pole barns and zoning site plans across Cincinnati, Dayton and Warren, Butler, Clermont and Greene counties, from an Ohio registered architect.
- [Northwest Ohio](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/regions/northwest-ohio/): Pole barns, farm and lake houses, additions and site plans across Lucas, Wood, Hancock, Ottawa and Allen counties, drawn by an Ohio registered architect.
- [Southeast Ohio](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/regions/southeast-ohio/): Cabins, houses, barns and site plans in the hills of southeast Ohio, from Athens and Marietta to the Hocking Hills and Gallipolis, by an Ohio registered architect.

## Guides

- [Do I need a permit for a pole barn in Ohio?](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/guides/pole-barn-permit-ohio/): It depends on the barn's use and where it is. Farm barns are outside the Ohio building code; garages and shops usually need a permit; every barn may need zoning.
- [Ohio's agricultural building exemption, explained](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/guides/ohio-agricultural-building-exemption/): How Ohio's agricultural building exemption works: the tests in ORC 3781.06 and 3781.061, the zoning limits in ORC 519.21, and what an exempt barn still needs.
- [What does a zoning site plan need in Ohio?](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/guides/zoning-site-plan-ohio/): What to show on a zoning site plan in Ohio: property lines, buildings, setbacks, drive, well, septic, easements, scale and north arrow, and who reviews it.
- [Do I need an architect for a house or addition in Ohio?](https://jameskehlarchitects.com/guides/do-i-need-an-architect-ohio/): Ohio does not require an architect's seal on plans for one-, two- and three-family homes. When you still need one, and when you are required to have one.
